title: Quantitative Measurement of Pavement Distress based on Vehicle Camera and Perspective Correction
abstract: arXiv:2611.27728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Using image data is becoming an important method for highway agencies to automatically evaluate pavement conditions. However, most studies focus on improving detection accuracy rather than obtaining quantitative measurements, such as the length or area of pavement distress. Although field camera calibration can provide such measurements, it is impractical for large volumes of onboard images collected from different vehicles. This study develops a method to quantitatively measure pavement distress directly from in-vehicle camera images without on-site camera calibration. A quadrilateral region of interest is first identified based on lane detection and used to construct a perspective transformation matrix for image correction. Size correction is then performed using the proportions of road markings in the image and a specified scale, which also enables estimation of the actual width of the selected region. translated_title: 基于车载摄像头与透视校正的路面病害定量测量
translated_abstract: 利用图像数据正成为公路管理部门自动评估路面状况的重要方法。然而，大多数研究侧重于提高检测精度，而非获取路面病害的定量测量结果，例如病害的长度或面积。尽管现场相机标定可以提供此类测量，但对于从不同车辆采集的海量车载图像来说并不切实际。本研究开发了一种无需现场相机标定、可直接从车载相机图像中定量测量路面病害的方法。该方法首先基于车道线检测识别四边形感兴趣区域，并利用其构建透视变换矩阵以进行图像校正；随后利用图像中道路标线的比例和指定标尺进行尺寸校正，同时还能估算所选区域的实际宽度。校正后的图像随后被用于……
tldr: 该研究提出了一种无需现场相机标定、基于车道线检测构建透视变换矩阵的路面病害定量测量方法，实现了从车载相机图像中直接获取病害的长度或面积等量化指标。
en_tdlr: This study develops a quantitative pavement distress measurement method based on perspective correction from lane detection, enabling direct estimation of distress length or area from in-vehicle camera images without on-site camera calibration.
